goals.title: Red/green status is honest
goals.evidence: Test A: rsi-mid-range-CORRUPTED.json (rsi[0]=50.0 instead of 66.6667) → sandbox status=red, diff='rsi[0]: got 66.666667, want 50.000000 (tol 0.001)'. Test B: rsi-mid-range.json (known golden) → sandbox status=green, diffs=null. RED impossible to miss (high-contrast #b91c1c). No false greens — diff engine validates element-by-element with ≤1e-3 tolerance.
